title: Euro 2012 Players to Watch: Manuel Neuer of Germany
content: # Euro 2012 Players to Watch: Manuel Neuer of Germany. Germany and Bayern Munich’s latest No. 1, Manuel Neuer, succeeded in proving his worth to the latter’s fans this past season. Neuer will be keen to play his part in ensuring the German national side go one better at Euro 2012. In keeping with the fortunes of a club who have not been able to add to their seven German championships since their last success in 1957-58, Neuer alone was unable to help bring the success Schalke fans crave, getting as close as runners-up in his inaugural Bundesliga season and again in 2009-10. One piece of silverware did arrive the following season in the form of the German Cup. Neuer was an ever-present, recording four clean sheets in six rounds (only conceding three goals), two of which came in the semifinals (a 1-0 win over Bayern) and in the 5-0 final demolition of MSV Duisburg.

title: Neuer's perfect quarter-final record a good omen for Germany? - Yahoo Sports
content: # Neuer's perfect quarter-final record a good omen for Germany? Goalkeeper Manuel Neuer will be a key figure in Germany's Euro 2024 quarter-final match against Spain, and the hosts will see it as a good omen that Neuer has never lost a last-eight match at a big event. Friday's match in Stuttgart will be the fifth quarter-final for the now 38-year-old from Bayern Munich who recorded his 50th clean sheet from 123 caps in a 2-0 win over Dennmark in the last 16 match. Germany will hope that he can extend his perfect quarter-final record against Spain, who have impressed most so far at the tournament and boast a fearsome forward line including yougsters Lamine Yamal and Nico Williams. Neuer's other quarter-final victories were 4-0 over Argentina at the 2010 World Cup, 4-2 over Greece at Euro 2012, and 1-0 over France at the 2014 World Cup. Neuer has won all club titles on offer with Bayern Munich as well as the 2014 World Cup, leaving the European title as the only missing silverware in his CV, just like for team-mates Toni Kroos and Thomas Müller.
